3587 xurao {xoo-rah'-o}

源自與 3586　相同的衍生字 (意為"剃刀"); 動詞

欽定本 - shave 3; 3

1) 剪毛, 剃去毛髮
2) 替自己刮臉剃毛 (#徒 21:24; 林前 11:5-6|)
record.edic_text:
3587 xurao {xoo-rah'-o}

from a derivative of the same as 3586 (meaning a razor);; v

AV - shave 3; 3

1) to shear, shave
2) to get one's self shaved
